worldcombat.skill.leechlife.summary: Latch onto the target and repeatedly drain health while remaining stationary. The target escapes by moving out of range.
The bite lands for about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
While latched each sip draws about %1$s damage, over %2$s sips.
%1$s of each sip's damage is restored to the user; once the target pulls %2$s blocks away the hold snaps and the draw ends early.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.deep.on: Deep bite: three heavy sips, each harder and siphoning more, with a longer hold, but slower wind-up and recovery and longer gaps so the target can escape.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.deep.off: Quick sips: five fast draws, tight and quick to recover, but each sip is lighter and the total is spread thinner.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and each sip to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.use.0: Latch onto one foe and bleed it for sustain
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.use.1: Get more out of a bulky, slow target
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.use.2: Stretch one contact hit into a sustained draw
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.preference.d: On: three heavy sips, each harder and siphoning more, with a longer hold, but slower wind-up and recovery and longer gaps so the target can escape. Off: five fast draws, tight and quick to recover, but each sip is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.leechlife.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger chases harder.
Below this health ratio the user prefers leech life as sustain; higher starts leaning on it for healing sooner.
